idea-plugin.name: Claude Usage Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Live dashboard for your Claude subscription while you work with Claude Code.
  • Current rate-limit utilisation of the connected Claude account (5-hour and 7-day windows, per model where available)
  • Subscription plan and rate-limit tier of the signed-in account
  • Model used by the active Claude Code session and how full its context window is
  • Forecast of when a window hits its limit and when the current chat should move to a new session
  • Estimated tokens left per window and per model, derived from local transcripts
  • Real-time chart, status bar widget and threshold notifications
All data is read from Claude Code's local files (~/.claude) and Anthropic's account usage endpoint. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

action.description: Fetch the latest usage from Anthropic and rescan local transcripts
Exchange the stored refresh token for a new access token
Open the Claude Usage Monitor settings
